goals: Ensure client-side application components (index.html, MSAL configuration) are correctly configured and linked.
Verify the server successfully serves the main application page (index.html).
activities: Read the content of 'index.html' from the file system.
Set the global document's HTML content to the read 'index.html'.
Get the element with ID 'load-msal' from the document.
Get the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element.
Load the MSAL configuration object from 'authConfig.js'.
Verify that the 'msalConfig' object is defined.
Define a regular expression for a GUID format.
Test if the 'clientId' property within 'msalConfig.auth' matches the GUID regular expression.
Verify that the 'clientId' matches the GUID format.
Define a regular expression for a URI format.
Test if the 'authority' property within 'msalConfig.auth' matches the URI regular expression.
Verify that the 'authority' matches the URI format.
Set the Node.js environment variable 'NODE_ENV' to 'test'.
Send a GET request to the root path ('/') of the application.
Read the content of 'index.html' from the file system for comparison.
Verify that the response status code is 200.
Verify that the response body text matches the content of the 'index.html' file.
